description: Defines the DialogManager class for handling bank reconciliation dialogs in ERPNext, including methods for showing dialogs, linking vouchers, creating entries, and updating transactions.

classes.name: DialogManager
classes.description: Class for managing bank reconciliation dialogs, including UI creation, data fetching, and transaction operations.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the DialogManager with company and bank account, and creates the dialog.

methods.name: show_dialog
methods.description: Displays the dialog for a specific bank transaction, fetching its details.

methods.name: get_linked_vouchers
methods.description: Fetches linked payment vouchers for the transaction and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: get_dt_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the data table displaying vouchers.

methods.name: get_datatable
methods.description: Creates or refreshes the data table with voucher data.

methods.name: make_dialog
methods.description: Constructs the dialog UI with fields and actions.

methods.name: get_selected_attributes
methods.description: Retrieves selected voucher attributes from the UI.

methods.name: update_options
methods.description: Updates voucher links based on selected attributes.

methods.name: reconciliation_dialog_primary_action
methods.description: Handles the primary action based on user selection: match, create voucher, or update transaction.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Performs voucher reconciliation for selected rows.

methods.name: add_payment_entry
methods.description: Creates a new payment entry based on dialog inputs.

methods.name: add_journal_entry
methods.description: Creates a new journal entry based on dialog inputs.

methods.name: update_transaction
methods.description: Updates the bank transaction with provided details.

methods.name: edit_in_full_page
methods.description: Opens the selected transaction in full page for editing.
